name: agent-qa
what: AI app testing through CLI and MCP for web, Android and iOS journeys. Persistent memidex memory and validated self-improvement retain useful experience across runs, with evidence for reviewing results.
who: Developers and QA teams who want their coding agents to run app checks and inspect failures.

setup.text: Install Node.js 24 or newer, then add agent-qa to your project.
Follow the official Quickstart to configure the workspace, test journeys and model authentication: https://vostride.com/docs/agent-qa/quickstart
From the configured project folder, start the local stdio MCP server.
Configure your MCP client to launch this command from the project folder. The server reads agent-qa.config.yaml there; setup details are at https://vostride.com/docs/agent-qa/mcp.
The runtime uses FSL-1.1-ALv2. Model and external service costs vary by configuration and usage.

prompts: Run the configured smoke tests and summarize failed assertions with their run evidence.
Show the evidence for the failed checkout step and explain what the application displayed.
